title: Multifaceted maleimide scaffolds in focus: from synthesis to photophysical applications
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00880H, Tutorial Review
Marcelo H. R. Carvalho, Gabriel M. F. Batista, Pedro P. de Castro, Brenno A. D. Neto, Giovanni W. Amarante
This tutorial reviews recent advances in unconventional synthesis of substituted maleimides via transition-metal catalysis or organocatalysis and highlights key concepts of their fluorescent properties and emission behavior.
